title: Your thinking is scattered.
voice: A useful conversation here. A decision there. Each agent gets a different piece of you.

title: New conversation. Same explaining.
voice: The context may still exist. But it stays inside that conversation, or provider.

title: The context is yours.
voice: Zenod gives your thoughts, learnings, and facts a home that your agents can share. Under your control.

title: Start with a thought.
voice: Here’s why I think I should buy this house. I can see myself living there for years. But I want to understand how rates and prices have moved over time.

title: Give it a place to grow.
voice: Zenod preserves the original and organizes the useful context into a linked personal wiki. Your thinking, with a reference back to its source.

title: Pick up where you left off.
voice: Later, bring that thinking into whichever agent you’re working with. Ask Codex to use yesterday’s house note, and analyse interest rates and house prices over the last fifty years.

title: What you learn becomes context, too.
voice: Your agent can read the background, and write useful findings back for next time. The next conversation starts with more context.

title: The context matters.
voice: You curate the context. Agents understand more of what you mean. Useful answers become new learnings. Correct, connect, and refine. Over years, even decades, your memory becomes more useful.

title: Keep the raw. Hire a smart librarian.
voice: You keep the library. You can fire the librarian. When a better librarian comes along, replace Zenod. Your library stays yours. Every original voice note, document, and source is preserved, ready for future discovery.

title: Start your personal Alexandria.
voice: Your agents change. Your context stays. Test Zenod free. Start curating your personal Alexandria of ideas. An Obsidian compatible wiki, inspired by Karpathy.
